2014_spells.summon-shadowspawn-egw.descr: You call forth a shadowy spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Shadow Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a fury, despair, or fear spirit. The creature resembles a shadow of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block.
2014_spells.summon-shadowspawn-egw.effec: Create a magical effect at a point you choose
2014_spells.summon-shadowspawn-egw.fullD: Using 1 action, when you cast the spell, choose a fury, despair, or fear spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range; You call forth a shadowy spirit; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the creature's statistics change as described in the spell's description. The effect lasts for up to 1 hour; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
